2\. Available Tools

audit\_fx\_transaction

Free tier

Score any FX transaction 1-10 with a qualitative verdict. Spread % and mid-market rate are never returned in the public response.



Input



{

  "amount": 10000,

  "currency\_from": "USD",

  "currency\_to": "EUR",

  "bank\_rate": 0.9123,

  "date": "2026-05-13"

}

Output (opaque public response)



{

  "score": 7,

  "color": "yellow",

  "verdict": "Fair FX pricing",

  "currency\_pair": "USD/EUR",

  "amount": 10000,

  "date": "2026-05-13",

  "encouragement": null

}

Rate limit: 10 audits / day per API key (free).



full\_forensic\_fx\_report

Paid tier ($199)

Full forensic audit including spread breakdown, projected loss, and partner routing intelligence. Requires a paid Bearer token.



Input



{

  "audit\_id": "uuid",

  "include\_routing": true

}

Output (opaque public response)



{

  "audit\_id": "uuid",

  "score": 4,

  "color": "orange",

  "verdict": "FX pricing above market expectations",

  "spread\_pct": 2.21,

  "mid\_market\_rate": 0.9241,

  "projected\_annual\_loss\_usd": 184500,

  "recommended\_partner": "ebury"

}

Rate limit: Unlimited on paid tier; priority routing.



check\_fx\_mid\_market\_rate

Free tier

Fetch the live mid-market reference rate for a currency pair. Returns both directions to help detect inverted quotes.



Input



{

  "base": "USD",

  "quote": "EUR"

}

Output (opaque public response)



{

  "pair": "USD/EUR",

  "mid\_market\_rate": 0.9241,

  "inverted\_pair": "EUR/USD",

  "inverted\_mid\_rate": 1.0821,

  "as\_of": "2026-05-13T12:00:00Z"

}

Rate limit: 60 calls / minute per API key.



3\. Authentication

Method: HTTP Bearer token in Authorization header.

Format: ipx\_live\_xxxxx (production) or ipx\_test\_xxxxx (sandbox).

How to get a key: Open your iPayX dashboard → API keys.

Authorization: Bearer ipx\_live\_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

Content-Type: application/json

Accept: application/json, text/event-stream

Quickstart

FX Audit — Quickstart

Here are three common ways to plug iPayX into your product.



FX broker / multi-currency platform

Send each client FX conversion (CAD→USD, EUR→CAD, etc.) to the iPayX API and return a 0–10 FX score with estimated hidden costs.



Corporate treasury

Feed your international payments (supplier invoices) into iPayX to compare bank rates vs mid-market and track margin impact.



Accounting firm / fractional CFO

Use the API to audit your clients' FX conversions at year-end and generate a standardized report with score and potential savings.

HOW PARTNER SCORING WORKS

When your API key makes an audit call, iPayX scores the client's bank rate AND your competitive rate — separately.



Example:

  Client bank spread   → 1.89% above mid → FX Score 1/10

  OFX configured rate  → 0.80% above mid → FX Score 5/10  (+4 improvement)

  Airwallex configured → 0.50% above mid → FX Score 7/10  (+6 improvement)

The client sees two scores. You don't fight the bank. You show the math. The client decides.
